items.item_text: Associate's Degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Demonstrated progressively responsible experience performing accounting or financial operations functions, including financial transactions, account reconciliations, accounts payable, or general ledger activities.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Working knowledge of accounting principles, practices, and financial transactions, including account reconciliations and journal entries.
Ability to analyze financial information, identify discrepancies, and resolve accounting issues of moderate complexity.
Ability to interpret and apply accounting, procurement, and financial policies and procedures, including applicable compliance and recordkeeping requirements.
Working knowledge of financial systems and proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications or comparable software, particularly Excel, with the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to evaluate the cost effectiveness of purchasing options and apply established procurement procedures, including reviewing basic contract terms and conditions.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple assignments and meet established deadlines.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
